cohort: Pregnant women with singleton pregnancies delivered after 20 weeks' gestation in Sydney, Australia. Cases were women with PA (positive salt suppression test), and controls were matched women with high- and low-risk pregnancies.
finding: Women with PA required more antihypertensives and had a longer postpartum length of stay than matched high-risk women, but similar rates of pre-eclampsia.
birth_weight: Reported but no specific values given
